sentence: This project builds a biosensor that uses CRISPR and a magnetic bead reporter to detect a gene needed to make toxins in harmful algal blooms.
This project builds computer simulation tools that use medical imaging to predict how bone fractures heal over time.
This project studies how Vibrio cholerae bacteria enter dormant states and what regulatory networks control this.
This project builds methods that let teams of robots judge risk and adjust their choices in crowded, changing places like hospitals.
This project builds an automated system that uses ion mobility spectrometry to quickly screen food for pathogens.
This project gets a microscope that uses Raman spectroscopy to study the structure of minerals, glasses and dissolved liquids and gases.
This project builds a laser system on a wheeled optical table so that many labs can share it.
This project builds a deep learning framework that finds, separates and sorts overlapping sources in astronomical survey images.
This project builds a confidential computing system that guards shared sensitive data from leaks and keeps records showing how computations were run.
This project builds deep learning models that learn from graph-structured data and studies higher order relations in it.
This project studies how corn and rice can work better with beneficial soil fungi to take up phosphorus.
This project studies how a mechanical resonator can measure the quantum properties of qubits built from double quantum dots.
This project uses computer simulations and theory to study why irregularities form in the plasma of the lower ionosphere.
This project explores whether chalcogenide semiconductors coupled to superconductors can reveal quantum dynamics in nanoscale devices.
This project builds deep learning tools that change a voice while keeping the speaker's identity and emotion, even in noisy environments.
